title: read-only-api-single-write-path
rationale: API is read-only for safety. POST /feedback is the only write path; it appends to JSONL and never mutates the in-memory index or reference data.

description: CIV_CERT/CIV_KEY empty strings caused IsADirectoryError in uvicorn SSL loader because Path('') resolves to Path('.') which is truthy.
resolution: Check the env var string (os.environ.get(...) or '') before constructing Path; treat empty strings as unset and fall through to dev-cert generation.

name: importlib-resources-bundled-data
description: Reference data is loaded via importlib.resources so the API works from an installed wheel, not just the repo. DataStore.default() resolves src/civ_api/data/ at call time.

name: textcontent-only-ui
description: Web UI (static/app.js) inserts all API-sourced text via textContent / createElement, never innerHTML, and uses no inline event handlers, eval, or document.write. This is the primary XSS defence and must be preserved when editing the front-end.

title: security-headers-middleware
rationale: Every response gets CSP (default-src self, frame-ancestors none, form-action self), nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, no-referrer, HSTS. Swagger /docs gets a narrowly relaxed CSP (unsafe-inline + cdn.jsdelivr.net) so its inline scripts load. Belt-and-braces on top of Pydantic validation and JSON-only responses.

description: sub_cmd pattern ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,4}$ rejected the valid empty string because the regex requires at least one char.
resolution: Use ^$|^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,4}$ so empty sub_cmd is accepted alongside 1-4 hex chars.

name: theme-toggle-external-script
description: Light/dark theme toggle uses an external script (static/theme.js) loaded in head, persisting to localStorage 'civ-theme' with dark as default. CSP forbids inline scripts, so the theme applies on DOMContentLoaded (brief pre-paint flash of default dark is the trade-off). Theme-toggle button with sun/moon SVGs lives in .header-actions; visibility is CSS-driven via [data-theme=light] selectors.

name: browse-pagination-all-commands
description: The Browse tab must page through ALL commands for a radio (500 per page loop until total reached) before grouping into command codes. The /radios/{id}/commands endpoint caps limit at 500, but the IC-9700 has 542 rows; a single fetch drops higher-numbered codes (21-28 sort last and vanish from the chip grid).

name: copy-button-dom-only-no-innerhtml
description: Copy-to-clipboard buttons on docs <pre> blocks are built with createElementNS for SVG icons (never innerHTML, which is the XSS defence invariant tested by test_static_js_served). Each <pre> is wrapped in a .pre-wrap container so the button stays pinned while the code scrolls horizontally. Uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with an execCommand fallback.

content: After ANY API/UI change, verify all three documentation surfaces stay in sync: (1) the OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (auto-generated by FastAPI from route definitions — always authoritative), (2) the in-UI docs table in src/civ_api/static/index.html (Endpoints table + code examples), (3) README.md API overview section. Check: endpoint list (GET /radios, /radios/{id}, /radios/{id}/capabilities, /commands, /radios/{id}/commands, POST /feedback, GET /feedback, GET /health), parameter names (q, radio_id, limit, offset), and response field names (radios: id/name/address/command_count; commands: radio_id/cmd/sub_cmd/data/description; capabilities: name/description/command_evidence/radios). Run pytest to confirm test_api.py still passes.

After ANY change to the capabilities (civ-radio-capabilities.json) or the Capability model (models.py), check all three documentation surfaces for field-name accuracy: (1) OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (auto-generated from Pydantic — always authoritative, verify it lists name/label/description/command_evidence/radios); (2) the capability object schema in the skill definition accordion inside static/index.html (must include the label field); (3) AGENTS.md docs-sync convention (the field-name list at line ~128 must say name/label/description/command_evidence/radios). README.md does not list individual capability fields so usually needs no change. Run pytest to confirm test_api.py still passes.

After ANY API/model change, verify FOUR documentation surfaces are in sync: (1) OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (auto-generated from Pydantic — always authoritative, verify Capability schema lists name/label/description/command_evidence/radios); (2) Swagger UI at /docs (renders from the OpenAPI spec — confirm it loads 200 and shows the updated schema, no manual edit needed since it's auto-rendered); (3) the in-UI docs in static/index.html (Endpoints table + code examples + skill definition accordion — must be hand-maintained, check capability object schema includes label); (4) AGENTS.md docs-sync convention (field-name list must include label). README.md rarely needs changes. Run pytest to confirm test_api.py still passes (test_swagger_csp_relaxed_for_docs, test_security_headers_present_on_html, test_index_page_served).

name: compare-radios-feature
description: The Radios tab has a checkbox column and a 'Compare selected' button (disabled until 2+ radios are checked). Clicking it fetches /radios/{id}/capabilities for each selected radio (cached in capsCache) and renders a side-by-side comparison table in #compare-result. Rows where values differ across radios get a blue-tinted compare-diff class. Booleans render as check/cross glyphs; string values display as-is. The capability list is the union of all selected radios, preserving the first radio's order. All rendering uses textContent/DOM APIs (no innerHTML) — preserves the XSS defence invariant.

name: live-site-feedback-triage-get-feedback-588fc5
description: Live-site feedback triage: GET /feedback on the deployed API returns the full JSONL log (no local copy exists in the repo). Workflow: review each item against local manuals (docs/icom manuals/*.raw.txt), apply verified corrections to CSVs, then prune the server-side feedback.jsonl manually. 2026-10-09 batch (6 items): waveform framing added to 27 00 rows of 705/7760/7300/7300mk2 (commit a3e948b); 7100 spectrum_scope=false already correct; one 'test' spam entry pruned server-side.

title: Feedback-log admin endpoints (PUT /feedback whole-log replace, DELETE /feedba...
rationale: Feedback-log admin endpoints (PUT /feedback whole-log replace, DELETE /feedback/{feedback_id}) are gated by HTTP Basic auth against CIV_ADMIN_USER/CIV_ADMIN_PASS server env vars, fail-closed 401 when unset, compared with secrets.compare_digest. Deployed site is containerized in Portainer (TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front): credentials are set as container env manually in Portainer; the agent-side client reads the matching credentials from .civ-admin.json (REPO ROOT, chmod 600, gitignored AND dockerignored — never commit and never bake into the image). Rotation = regenerate both sides. Client: scripts/feedback_admin.py (stdlib pull/list/rm/push; push requires --yes; GET /feedback stays public). Admin PUT body is the exact JSONL format GET returns so pull/edit/push round-trips; replace writes are atomic (unique temp file + os.replace); validation is all-or-nothing (400 with line number on the first bad record).

name: live-site-verification-2026-10-09-742c17
description: Live-site verification 2026-10-09 (post-deploy): the Portainer/reverse-proxy topology in front of icom-civ.stevendodd.net DOES forward the Authorization header (Basic auth verified end-to-end: 401 unauth/wrong-password on PUT+DELETE, 200 authed, 404 on unknown-id DELETE, 201 public POST, ack counts correct). TLS termination + auth forwarding confirmed working; feedback log pruned to empty via scripts/feedback_admin.py push --yes of an empty file (replaced: 6 removed, 0 kept).

title: GET /feedback (log download) is now admin-only, HTTP Basic auth via the same...
rationale: GET /feedback (log download) is now admin-only, HTTP Basic auth via the same require_admin dependency as PUT/DELETE (fail-closed 401 when CIV_ADMIN_USER/CIV_ADMIN_PASS unset). Supersedes the earlier decision that GET /feedback stays public (mx-aa822d) and the mx-ed8933-era visibility model. POST /feedback (submit) stays PUBLIC and no-auth by design — pinned by test_post_feedback_public_even_without_admin_env. Rationale: the log carries submitter-controlled handle/email text and unreviewed drafts; nothing external depends on public download (UI only POSTs; feedback_admin.py always sends Authorization, so pull/list keep working). The Feedback tab download link and its a[download] CSS rule were removed so the Basic-auth dialog never appears on the public UI.

name: live-verification-2026-10-09-second-40cb81
description: Live verification 2026-10-09 (second deploy, commit 1e19be4+26002dd): GET /feedback now admin-only in production — unauth 401, wrong-password 401, authed pull/list 200; POST /feedback confirmed PUBLIC and unauthenticated (201 live, probe record rm'd immediately); OpenAPI: GET/PUT security=[HTTPBasic], POST security=None; qso_recorder=7100 true with evidence 0x1A 0x05 0x0167-0x0172 live; Feedback tab download link gone from served HTML; no auth prompts on public pages (homepage 200, zero download-link occurrences).

content: Feedback triage policy (user decision 2026-10-09): items that need NO data change (confirmations, already-satisfied asks) are pruned from the live feedback log after verification — the log only ever holds unreviewed items. Where meaningful, prefer a descriptive string value in the radios map (existing convention, cf. attenuator) over a bare false/true when a capability's support state needs explanation (e.g. voice_tx_memory 7100 = 'false (feature exists; not CI-V addressable — no 0x28 command)').

description: feedback_admin.py push trap: a bare 'push --yes' replaces the server log with the LOCAL feedback-live.jsonl (the last pull). After pruning records server-side via rm, a stale push RE-UPLOADS the deleted items (2026-10-17: 18 rm'd, then push restored all 18). Safe workflow: pull, prune locally OR rm server-side, explicitly control the pushed file, confirm with fresh pull.
resolution: Clear via empty-file push: ': > feedback-live.jsonl && push --yes'; then confirm with a fresh pull

description: Recurring model failure 2026-10-17: during ambiguous manual-parsing reasoning, responses degenerated into repeated filler runs ('hmm'/('=' walls)) instead of taking the next tool step; user saw one as 'output is just equal signs'. Recovers when switching to strictly deterministic micro-steps (marker-slice file splices, evidence-before-analysis, one short paragraph between calls).
resolution: Small verified steps; hard stop when a loop is noticed; user asked to be told and to interrupt.
